title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 32
paragraphs: About a Hyperborean people the Scythians report nothing, nor do any who dwell in this region, unless it be the Issedonians; but in my opinion these too say nothing, for if they did the Scythians would report it too, as they do about the one-eyed people. Hesiod, however, has spoken of Hyperboreans, and so has Homer in the poem Epigonoi—at least if Homer was really the composer of that epic.
